passed.name: VersionHistoryContract
passed.description: Provides operations to list version directories and perform rollback on remote server.

methods.name: listVersions
methods.description: Lists all deployed version directories on the remote server for a given environment.
methods.signature: listVersions(environmentId: string): Promise<{ versions: { name: string; createdAt: string; }[] }>
methods.precondition: environmentId must be a valid non-empty string corresponding to an existing environment configuration.
methods.postcondition: Returns an array of version objects with name and createdAt if successful, or throws an error if SSH connection fails.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Updates the current symlink to point to the specified target version directory.
methods.signature: rollback(environmentId: string, targetVersion: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }>
methods.precondition: environmentId must be valid, targetVersion must be a non-empty string matching an existing version directory name on the remote server.
methods.postcondition: Returns a RollbackResult indicating success or failure, and logs the operation. The remote server's current symlink is updated to the target version if successful.

invariants: 环境 ID 必须对应有效的环境配置
回滚目标版本必须存在于远程服务器的版本目录中
回滚操作前必须验证 current 软链接的存在性
validations: targetVersion 不能为空，且必须与现有版本目录名匹配
